_README: Copy this to demo-config.local.json (same folder) and edit that copy. demo-config.local.json is git-ignored - never commit it. The current install path is documented in docs/install/README.md.
_EDIT_THESE_FIRST: Set azure.subscriptionId, azure.tenantId, azure.location, then fill handoffOrchestrator.dataverse and foundryRelay after those resources exist.

handoffOrchestrator._comment: Azure Functions handoff service. Current supported paths are /api/cua-run for MCS and /api/foundry-claims/* for Foundry. The legacy Direct Line/engine fields below are intentionally blank.

appRegistration._comment: Zava sign-in SPA app. clientSecret is not used for the supported browser sign-in path and should stay blank.

agentPool._comment: Device group that receives the Claims Win32 app on the Copilot Studio (MCS) pool. Use the dynamic CPCPool_ group created by scripts/Enable-W365aPrereqs.ps1 -CreateDynamicGroup (same name). The Foundry pool uses its own assigned group (docs/install/03-tenant-and-cloud-pcs.md step 2.6).

agentWorkstation._comment: Human presenter users who receive the Zava Edge web app/PWA.

foundry._comment: Foundry hosted agent values. Deployment uses deploy/foundry/foundry-agent.local.json; these values only help older helper scripts and documentation.
